summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Whiteboard Agent - voice-first conversational whiteboard app. All backend APIs and frontend functionality working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend /api/health endpoint returns ok status
Backend /api/chat endpoint processes messages and returns AI responses with whiteboard_update commands
Backend /api/tts endpoint converts text to speech audio successfully
Backend /api/session/reset endpoint resets session correctly
Frontend loads with empty whiteboard state and conversation sidebar
User can switch from voice mode to text mode using the 'Aa' button
User can type messages in text input and send them
AI responses appear in conversation sidebar
Whiteboard canvas renders title scene with handwritten font on first message
Whiteboard canvas renders pros/cons scene on follow-up messages
Session controls show correct scene count
Reset button clears the board and messages
Export button downloads SVG file when scenes are present
Export button is disabled when no scenes are present
Sidebar can be closed and reopened
Voice mode UI elements are present and functional
SVG whiteboard scenes render with proper Caveat handwritten font
Framer-motion animations work correctly
OpenRouter GPT-4o-mini integration working
ElevenLabs TTS integration working
